$comment: Tip-jar products for Google Play and the App Store. Product ids are fixed in the app (services/tip-jar.ts, TipJarPlugin.java, TipJarPlugin.swift); names, descriptions and prices are store data and may be changed here or in the consoles at any time. `price` is the consumer price in EUR for Germany; `defaultVatRate` is only used to derive the tax-exclusive base that Google's price converter expects; the App Store takes the EUR price as its base price in `appStore.baseTerritory` and derives the other territories itself. `listings.<locale>.title`/`description` are the Play texts (55/200 characters); `appStoreDescription` is the App Store description (45 characters, the title is shared and capped at 30). The package name / bundle id comes from src/web/capacitor.config.ts. Apply with `node src/store/play-products.mjs --apply` and `node src/store/asc-products.mjs --apply`.

appStore.reviewNote: Optional tip (consumable) in Settings > Support. It unlocks nothing; the app is fully free with or without it.
